newsitem.title: CHINA: Erfangji posts loss for 2nd year.
newsitem.headline: Erfangji posts loss for 2nd year.

text.p: Shanghai Erfangji Co Ltd on Tuesday posted a net loss in 1996 for the second year in a row under international accounting standards
The company's 1996 annual report said the firm lost 69.739 million yuan net in 1996, compared with a 75.64 million net loss in 1995.
Under domestic accounting standards, the firm had a net profit of 1.223 million yuan in 1996, down sharply from 18.089 million yuan in 1995, the report said.
The textile machinery maker said China's textile industry had unprecedented difficulties in 1996, the report said, but gave no gave no details.
The firm said in its 1995 annual report its 1995 results were poor because of Beijing's continued austerity measures.
The company's board of directors proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue based on the firm's capital reserves, pending approval at a shareholders meeting on June 5, the report said.
